title: Implement portable command worker runtime entrypoint
description: Provide the portable runtime process used by a command-worker container. Configure delivery and durable lifecycle adapters from explicit environment bindings, load a consumer-supplied executor through a stable plugin boundary, and keep dashboard and consumer execution behavior out of the runtime. Add focused configuration and process-startup validation.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented the portable worker runtime entrypoint: validated environment bindings, explicit integration-owned executor plugin loading, SQS Celery configuration using a supplied queue URL, DynamoDB lifecycle binding, and a package CLI. Local validation passed: python -m pytest tests/command_worker -q (103 passed); python -m behave -q tests/command_worker/features (30 scenarios passed); ruff check plexus/command_worker tests/command_worker; black --check plexus/command_worker/runtime plexus/command_worker/adapters tests/command_worker/test_runtime_entrypoint.py tests/command_worker/test_celery_delivery.py tests/command_worker/test_dynamodb_lifecycle.py.
